Nora Patel: quick thread to lock MVP for the Optimize Toolkit pilot focused on cost-saving recs (batching/caching/quant guidance + eval-triggered alerts). Need a hard cut for the 6-week window. Thoughts?

Ibrahim Khan: Keep MVP narrow: 1) per-route batching recommendations with confidence + expected cost delta, 2) KV-prefix cache TTL suggestions with hit-rate estimate, 3) JSON exportable config snippets + Node/Python examples, 4) eval-triggered webhook that posts to Slack. Quantization: doc-only playbook.

Keiko Tanaka: Agree. Important: every recommendation must include a one-line rationale and an "explainability" tag (e.g., "high payload similarity") so engineers can reason quickly. Recommend we show dollar-estimate using a per-GPU cost model.

Samir Rao: From infra: require a 14-day telemetry window and a lightweight simulator that takes sampled traces to predict p95/p99 changes. Canary application should support traffic tags and auto-revert if p99 or eval quality regresses beyond thresholds.

Nora Patel: Draft acceptance criteria: (a) recommender emits ranked recs for batching + caching with confidence, cost %, and p95/p99 estimates; (b) exportable JSON + SDK snippet; (c) eval webhook -> Slack (PD toggle optional); (d) docs + 2 pilot customers onboarded.

Ibrahim Khan: Ranking formula proposal: score = 0.5*normalized_cost_saving + 0.25*latency_benefit - 0.25*quality_risk. We'll include a small sample API response in the doc. Example response: `{"route":"/v1/generate","type":"batching","confidence":0.88,"expected_cost":"-12%","expected_p95_ms":30,"explain":"low token variance"}`.

Keiko Tanaka: UX notes: show quick "rollback recipe" and an actionable severity flag (autoflag if paired-eval delta > 1%). Also make the export snippet copyable and SDK-ready. CS wants a one-page quickstart.

Samir Rao: Canary guardrails: apply to <=3% traffic, run paired-eval on historical prompts, auto-revert if absolute quality drop >1% or p99 increases >25%. We'll log p95/p99 and evaluation delta per canary window.

planner-bot: Created card OPT-7120 with subtasks: recommender-poc, simulator, sdk-exports, eval-webhook, pilot-runbook. Link: https://projects.internal/OPT-7120

Nora Patel: Timeline: recommender POC + simulator = 2 sprints, SDK export + docs = 0.5 sprint, eval webhook + alerts = 0.5 sprint. Decision: ship suggest+export only. Auto-apply and auto-quant deferred. Action owners: @Ibrahim recommender, @Samir infra/simulator, @Keiko docs/pilot outreach.

Ibrahim Khan: I'll draft the API schema and a short design note by Tue EOD.

Keiko Tanaka: I'll reach out to HealthWorks and NovaGen for pilot seats and prepare chat + long-form evals.

Samir Rao: I'll ensure the simulator includes a simple cost->dollar conversion per common GPU types and that exports include the dollar estimate.

Nora Patel: Locking scope now: "suggest + export, eval webhook to Slack, docs + 2 pilots". Quant automation and auto-apply deferred to next cycle. If no objections, I'll publish the sprint brief.
